results.label: the backup carries a versioned practice bundle and nothing more
the exported records carry no score, streak or summary field
the export keeps the measured running time and the trader’s own words
the restored session is labelled imported, never recorded
the restored session keeps its original clock and version as history
restoring never touches the trader’s own recorded day
progress counts the archive separately and never merges it
importing the same archive twice adds a second archive rather than editing the first
malformed archives warn instead of pretending to restore
a record with no readable day is kept without claiming a day
a record with an unusable duration or preset is omitted, not repaired
a record with an unlisted ambience falls back to none rather than inventing a sound
a foreign trader importing the same bundle keeps their own archive counts
the export of the receiver still carries their own records only
deleting the trader removes their archives with them

scope: M108 practice backup and restore: actual runtime/auth/SQL/DOM, fixedUTC and tiny raster/literal journals; not real chart/provider/broker/pixel/production or mental-state proof
